resources.string: Point your camera. Hear what the medicine label says.
To identify medicine labels on-device, this app needs access to your phone camera. All image processing stays completely offline on your device.
The app cannot scan medicine packaging without camera permission. You can grant permission to continue.
Camera permission was permanently denied. Please open Android App Settings to enable Camera permission for AR Medicine Identifier.
Hold the medicine package steady 15–25 cm from the camera in good lighting, avoiding glare on blister foils.
Academic Proof of Concept — Not for clinical or diagnostic use.
